items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: So afterwards Stan Getz told me he says, “Man you sound better than — you’re one of the greatest scat singers.”

ctx.x: The other thing, I was doing a scat thing. One of Stan Getz, he used to hang out with Morey Stein, so I did a thing and I was scat singing. Morey had died and there was a Alfonse’s, it’s a club. So afterwards Stan Getz told me he says, “Man you sound better than — you’re one of the greatest scat singers.” That’s what he told me. You know so that was a nice compliment.
When did the idea of singing through the flute start for you?
